certified_services.serviceDescription: Conversational research and analysis across public and authorized agency data.
Search API, Sonar API, Agent API, and Embeddings API.

certified.useCase: Amazon Bedrock is a cloud provider used for artificial intelligence research and deployment. Inference capacity, reliability, and model availability.
Amazon Web Services is a cloud provider used for cloud infrastructure and security. Core compute, infrastructure, account-level security, and production service availability.
Cloudflare is a cloud monitoring provider used for edge network and security infrastructure. DDoS and WAF protection for the public apex zone.
Datadog is a cloud monitoring provider used for cloud monitoring and observability. Operational monitoring and alerting of platform health and security/availability signals.

Google Cloud is a cloud provider used for artificial intelligence research and deployment, including AI models like Gemini. Gemini models (including Gemini 3.1 Pro) are offered as selectable and default AI models within Perplexity's own products, including Search, Model Council, and Enterprise plans.
OpenAI is a cloud provider used for artificial intelligence research and deployment. OpenAI models are offered as selectable third-party models.

Snowflake is a data storage and processing provider used as a cloud data warehouse and analytics platform. Data warehouse/analytics and data movement, including the Polytomic Snowflake ↔ Salesforce workflow.

current.service_desc:
Perplexity's Enterprise platform provides agency users with access to leading frontier AI models (including OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Perplexity Sonar, and more). The platform supports research and analysis across internal agency data and public sources through an intuitive conversational interface. Built on Perplexity's exabyte-scale proprietary knowledge index, responses are grounded in verifiable sources, providing trustworthy, transparent, and reliable information to users.

Through Perplexity's Search API, developers may also access Perplexity's exabyte-scale knowledge index to provide web-grounded answers in real time. The index tracks over 300bn unique URLs and processes hundreds of millions of pages per day, providing agencies a durable foundation for real time web retrieval.

Perplexity's features include robust security and compliance measures such as SAML SSO, customizable access controls and data retention, comprehensive administrative management, audit logs, and dedicated priority support. Perplexity Enterprise minimizes the risks inherent in single-model solutions, with Perplexity's model-agnostic architecture providing greater uptime and empowering IT administrators to enable and disable specific models to enforce policy compliance.
